evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Skill Research Batch 459.
findings: 100-Ki Strike Super learned from Broly training. The user takes a stance and throws a large Ki Blast from the right hand; current skill-specific evidence reports about 15% damage at close range and 10% at long range. It is documented as a pseudo-Ki Blast with 1–3 hits and knockback. Exact frame data and patch-independent scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent scaling is not inferred from source-reported values.
Reward probabilities and hidden prerequisites are not promoted unless directly evidenced.
